entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return these absolutely worthless cycling shoes I bought. This is a joke.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with them. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF88602. And I don't want to talk, I just want my money back. This is completely unacceptable.
Okay, I'm pulling up order VF88602 now. I see the Performance Road cycling shoes. Just so I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

The issue is they're garbage! I've tried adjusting the cleats a dozen times, but no matter what I do, they give me horrible blisters after every single ride. They're painful and I can't use them. I want a refund.

I understand. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers, and I'm sorry you've had to deal with that. Let me just review the return eligibility for you. I see the order was delivered 46 days ago.

I don't care if it was 100 days ago! Your products are supposed to be premium. This is false advertising! If you don't process this return right now, I'm going to leave a review on every website I can find. Put your manager on the phone!

There's no need for that, sir, I can resolve this for you directly. You're well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return and get you a full refund. I'm generating a prepaid shipping label to send to your email right now.
Wait, really? You're just... approving it?

Yes, of course. Your satisfaction is important to us. The label is in your inbox now. Just pack the cycling shoes in a box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Oh. Okay. Well... that's... good. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
